business_problem: Previously, the company faced challenges with complete data integration and management, real-time data processing, scalability, and performance, making it difficult for customers to effectively generate insightful revenue intelligence.
solution_summary: Revenue Grid modernized its analytics estate on Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Fabric and related services unify streaming, lake, warehouse, and BI capabilities so analysts and frontline teams can query fresher data without stitching together separate products. The integration between Cloud Services and Revenue Grid helps organizations centralize data and optimize sales performance. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.
